map.立式圆柱 V = π·(直径/2)²·液位高: Vertical cylinder: V = π·(diameter/2)² × level height
map.长方体 V = 长 × 宽 × 液位高: Rectangular tank: V = length × width × level height
map.立式圆柱 V = π(d/2)²·h；长方体 V = 长×宽×h；卧式圆柱按液位: Vertical cylinder: V = π(d/2)²·h. Rectangular: V = L×W×h. Horizontal cylinder uses the circular-segment area: V = L·[R²·arccos((R−h)/R) − (R−h)·√(2Rh−h²)] with R = d/2 and h ≤ d. Reverse level: divide by the base area for vertical/rectangular tanks; bisection for horizontal tanks. Fill ratio = current volume ÷ full volume × 100%; full volume is π(d/2)²·L for cylinders and d·W·L for rectangular tanks. Validation: dimensions must be positive, level must not exceed tank height (or diameter for horizontal), and target volume must not exceed full volume.
